meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 vercel 命令把你的网页应用部署到 Vercel 线上,并在确认构建通过、网址能正常访问后才把链接发给你;也能管理项目、域名和环境变量。
howto.when: 当你要求部署、上线或发布网页应用,或要管理 Vercel 项目、域名、环境变量时接管。

say.text: 把这个项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境
say.note: 先本地构建,成功后再部署上线

say.text: 列出 Vercel 上最近的部署记录
say.note: 运行 vercel ls 查看部署列表

say.text: 把 example.com 加到当前 Vercel 项目
say.note: 运行 vercel domains add 添加域名

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude deploys your web app to Vercel with the vercel CLI, checks the build and live URL before sharing the link, and can manage projects, domains, and env vars.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to deploy, ship, or publish a web app, or to manage Vercel projects, domains, or environment variables.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production

say_en.note: Runs vercel ls to show deployments

say_en.text: Add example.com to the current Vercel project
